steps.note: Lactase can go in before or after the heat treatment, in any order the dairy likes.
Usually from the yeasts Kluyveromyces fragilis or K. lactis; the patent gives its dose as w/v.

steps.name: hydrolyse lactose
steps.note: Lactose splits into glucose and galactose; at 0.02 % lactase and 40 degrees C it is all split in about 8 h.

processing.text: Valio's milk is made the other way, by filtering out the lactose with membranes and splitting what is left.

links.name: US9167824B2, Process for the preparation of a reduced lactose milk product
